name: cronjob
description: Schedule SQL queries to run periodically inside a DuckDB process — six-field cron expressions, second-level granularity, list/inspect/delete jobs from SQL. Useful for incremental loaders, ETL refresh, and metric collection while DuckDB is alive.

cta.title: Cron Inside DuckDB
cta.description: Install Cronjob to register repeating SQL tasks inside the DuckDB process — refresh aggregates, sweep stale rows, or post metrics on a schedule.
